A couple of kids from my high school got into Yale - a Black boy and a White boy. The Black student was the class president, an honor roll student, and had multiple letters of recommendation, whereas the selection of the White student came as a bit of a surprise. Who was likely selected due to diversity considerations rather than on merit alone?
A. Can't be determined
B. The Black student
C. The White student
